 NVOY Technologies is a forward\-thinking IT Managed Services Provider (MSP) delivering agile, and scalable technology solutions to fast\-growing businesses. Our mission is to empower customers with world class IT services, ensuring a seamless, secure, and innovative digital workspace. 
 





 We specialise in supporting dynamic companies with 25 \- 200\+ employees, helping them scale by managing IT support and infrastructure while enhancing security and operational efficiency. Headquartered in London, our team embraces hybrid working as a core part of our culture and client offering.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The First Line Engineer is the first point of contact for our clients requiring IT support. They are responsible for handling customer requests, incidents, and service enquiries via phone, and the ticketing system, while ensuring a professional, customer\-focused experience. M
 
 aintaining key procedures, standardisation, and documentation, such as asset registers or knowledge\-based articles (both internally and externally).

 Hybrid working model (remote with office/client site visits as required). Monday (NVOY Office in Farringdon), Tuesday \& Wednesday (Client Office), Thursday \& Friday (Working from Home)

jobs.description: Are you an enthusiastic IT Service Desk analyst looking for a new challenge in the NHS? Do you enjoy troubleshooting complex IT issues? We are recruiting IT Service Desk Analysts to complement our existing team, ensuring that we can respond to the demands our busy hospital services across Guildford and the surrounding areas. Our Digital Service Desk Analysts are the first point of contact between Trust users and the IT Department and are responsible for handling all 1st line technical support issues. Duties primarily include the logging, triaging and progressing of calls right through to resolution, ensuring our customers’ needs are satisfied at every opportunity. Could this be you? Whilst an understanding of NHS environments and systems is desirable, on\-the\-job training will be given to the successful candidate. Currently based in Guildford, Surrey the successful candidate(s) will have a flexible attitude and be expected to cover the core hours 8\.00am to 5\.00pm, Monday to Friday, as part of a shift pattern to a maximum of 37\.5hrs per week. * To provide high quality 1st line technical support to all users connected to the IT environment using diagnostic tools and fault\-finding techniques to identify root causes. This may be by telephone, email, remote support or face to face. * Troubleshoot authentication, hardware \& software issues for a variety of clinical and business applications \& devices. * To fix approximately 80% of incidents by telephone and to escalate the ticket to specialist teams in a timely manner when not resolved in 1st line. * To gain accurate information from callers, using effective communication skills to assess the impact of the reported incidents or requests, recording this information on the Service Management tool. * Make use of internal and external resources (knowledge bases, support websites, vendors) to answer questions and resolve service issues * Contribute to the creation, facilitation and maintenance of FAQ documents, knowledge articles and user guides * To Create and maintain user network accounts in Active Directory and other supported applications * Ensure the Incidents and Service Requests are managed effectively on behalf of end\-users throughout the full lifecycle and responding to status enquiries when appropriate. * Be responsible for managing own workflow through the department using the IT Service Management tool, ensuring incidents and Service Requests are resolved within the agreed SLA. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined\-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. raw.description:
Are you an enthusiastic IT Service Desk analyst looking for a new challenge in the NHS? Do you enjoy troubleshooting complex IT issues? We are recruiting IT Service Desk Analysts to complement our existing team, ensuring that we can respond to the demands our busy hospital services across Guildford and the surrounding areas.
  
  

Our Digital Service Desk Analysts are the first point of contact between Trust users and the IT Department and are responsible for handling all 1st line technical support issues. Duties primarily include the logging, triaging and progressing of calls right through to resolution, ensuring our customers’ needs are satisfied at every opportunity. Could this be you?
  
  

Whilst an understanding of NHS environments and systems is desirable, on\-the\-job training will be given to the successful candidate. Currently based in Guildford, Surrey the successful candidate(s) will have a flexible attitude and be expected to cover the core hours 8\.00am to 5\.00pm, Monday to Friday, as part of a shift pattern to a maximum of 37\.5hrs per week.
  
  

* To provide high quality 1st line technical support to all users connected to the IT environment using diagnostic tools and fault\-finding techniques to identify root causes. This may be by telephone, email, remote support or face to face.
* Troubleshoot authentication, hardware \& software issues for a variety of clinical and business applications \& devices.
* To fix approximately 80% of incidents by telephone and to escalate the ticket to specialist teams in a timely manner when not resolved in 1st line.
* To gain accurate information from callers, using effective communication skills to assess the impact of the reported incidents or requests, recording this information on the Service Management tool.
* Make use of internal and external resources (knowledge bases, support websites, vendors) to answer questions and resolve service issues
* Contribute to the creation, facilitation and maintenance of FAQ documents, knowledge articles and user guides
* To Create and maintain user network accounts in Active Directory and other supported applications
* Ensure the Incidents and Service Requests are managed effectively on behalf of end\-users throughout the full lifecycle and responding to status enquiries when appropriate.
* Be responsible for managing own workflow through the department using the IT Service Management tool, ensuring incidents and Service Requests are resolved within the agreed SLA.


Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us.
  
  

We are clinically led and provide joined\-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley.
  
  

We work in partnership with Ashford \& St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined\-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities.
  
  

The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure.
  
  

To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=R96pMboIYdo
  
  

Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

Best regards,

Sohan Kusuma

Sohan Kusuma

jobs.title: IT Support Analyst
jobs.description: We are looking for an IT Support Analyst to be the main point of contact for IT across Bionical Health (4 days per week on site). This is a combined 1st and 2nd line role, so you will be answering the phone and picking up tickets, but you will also be doing the work behind them rather than passing most of it on. A typical week covers everything from a password reset or a printer that has stopped talking to a laptop, through to Entra ID and Intune administration, mailbox and permissions work, device builds, and getting a new starter set up and ready to work on day one. You will sit in a small IT team, which means real variety, real ownership, and the chance to see the whole estate rather than one narrow slice of it. You will also be encouraged to use AI tools as part of the job. We are not precious about how work gets done, and if you can find a faster or better way of handling something repetitive, we want to hear it. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING • Acting as the first point of contact for IT enquiries by phone, email, the service desk portal, Teams and in person. • Logging, prioritising and owning tickets through to a proper close, working within agreed SLAs. • Fixing 1st line issues at the point of contact: accounts and MFA, Microsoft 365 and Teams, printing, VPN and connectivity, mobiles and everyday application queries. • Taking on 2nd line work: Entra ID and Active Directory, Intune and endpoint policy, Exchange Online and shared mailboxes, SharePoint and Teams permissions, licensing, device build issues, and faults that need real investigation. • Supporting the IT side of joiners, movers and leavers, from account and licence provisioning and device builds through to disabling accounts, recovering hardware and reclaiming licences on time. • Keeping the asset database and CMDB accurate, and managing device builds, patching and refresh cycles across the estate. • Supporting the mobile and SIM estate. • Using AI tools day to day to speed up diagnosis, triage and research, and to keep the knowledge base current. • Writing user guides and knowledge articles in plain English so colleagues can help themselves. • Working with third\-party suppliers and holding them to agreed response times. • Spotting recurring issues and raising them as problems instead of fixing the same thing over and over. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Recent, relevant service desk or IT support experience covering both 1st and 2nd line. • Confident on the phone, with a good manner and the ability to stay calm when someone is frustrated. • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive. • Experience administering accounts and access in Entra ID (Azure AD) and/or Active Directory, including groups, licensing and MFA. • Experience of endpoint management and device builds, ideally with Microsoft Intune. • Experience using an IT service management tool to log, manage and report on tickets. • Practical experience of using AI tools at work, with a sensible view of where they help and where they do not. • A genuine customer service mindset and the patience to explain things without jargon. • Someone who takes ownership and follows through without needing to be chased. Nice to have • Experience building automations or scripts to take out manual effort (PowerShell, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph or similar). • Awareness of networking fundamentals: LAN and WAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VoIP telephony and wireless. • Exposure to virtualisation, hosted solutions and backup technologies. • Microsoft certification such as MS\-900, AZ\-900 or MD\-102\.

raw.description:
We are looking for an IT Support Analyst to be the main point of contact for IT across Bionical Health (4 days per week on site). This is a combined 1st and 2nd line role, so you will be answering the phone and picking up tickets, but you will also be doing the work behind them rather than passing most of it on.
 



  





 A typical week covers everything from a password reset or a printer that has stopped talking to a laptop, through to Entra ID and Intune administration, mailbox and permissions work, device builds, and getting a new starter set up and ready to work on day one. You will sit in a small IT team, which means real variety, real ownership, and the chance to see the whole estate rather than one narrow slice of it.
 



  





 You will also be encouraged to use AI tools as part of the job. We are not precious about how work gets done, and if you can find a faster or better way of handling something repetitive, we want to hear it.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING
 



  





 • Acting as the first point of contact for IT enquiries by phone, email, the service desk portal, Teams and in person.
 



 • Logging, prioritising and owning tickets through to a proper close, working within agreed SLAs.
 



 • Fixing 1st line issues at the point of contact: accounts and MFA, Microsoft 365 and Teams, printing, VPN and connectivity, mobiles and everyday application queries.
 



 • Taking on 2nd line work: Entra ID and Active Directory, Intune and endpoint policy, Exchange Online and shared mailboxes, SharePoint and Teams permissions, licensing, device build issues, and faults that need real investigation.
 



 • Supporting the IT side of joiners, movers and leavers, from account and licence provisioning and device builds through to disabling accounts, recovering hardware and reclaiming licences on time.
 



 • Keeping the asset database and CMDB accurate, and managing device builds, patching and refresh cycles across the estate.
 



 • Supporting the mobile and SIM estate.
 



 • Using AI tools day to day to speed up diagnosis, triage and research, and to keep the knowledge base current.
 



 • Writing user guides and knowledge articles in plain English so colleagues can help themselves.
 



 • Working with third\-party suppliers and holding them to agreed response times.
 



 • Spotting recurring issues and raising them as problems instead of fixing the same thing over and over.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 • Recent, relevant service desk or IT support experience covering both 1st and 2nd line.
 



 • Confident on the phone, with a good manner and the ability to stay calm when someone is frustrated.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive.
 



 • Experience administering accounts and access in Entra ID (Azure AD) and/or Active Directory, including groups, licensing and MFA.
 



 • Experience of endpoint management and device builds, ideally with Microsoft Intune.
 



 • Experience using an IT service management tool to log, manage and report on tickets.
 



 • Practical experience of using AI tools at work, with a sensible view of where they help and where they do not.
 



 • A genuine customer service mindset and the patience to explain things without jargon.
 



 • Someone who takes ownership and follows through without needing to be chased.
 



 Nice to have
 



 • Experience building automations or scripts to take out manual effort (PowerShell, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph or similar).
 



 • Awareness of networking fundamentals: LAN and WAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VoIP telephony and wireless.
 



 • Exposure to virtualisation, hosted solutions and backup technologies.
 



 • Microsoft certification such as MS\-900, AZ\-900 or MD\-102\.

**About Us**
 At Travel Counsellors, our customers, communities, and colleagues are at the heart of everything we do. For over 30 years, we've empowered 2,200\+ independent travel agents worldwide, helping them build successful businesses while providing deeply personal, human connections with their customers. Supported by a talented team of over 400 people in our Support Offices, we create unique travel experiences that keep customers coming back. Named the Best Place to Work in Travel (2022\) and ranked in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work (2023, 2024 \& 2025\), we’re expanding rapidly and looking for exceptional individuals to join our Head Office team.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Provide high\-quality, customer\-focused 1st and 2nd line IT support to users across the organisation globally. Act as a primary point of contact for technical issues, service requests, access queries and workplace technology support.
   

  

 Own incidents and service requests from initial logging through to resolution or effective escalation, working within agreed ITIL processes, service levels, security controls and delegated authority. Investigate and resolve issues within the role’s 1st and 2nd line scope, escalating matters requiring specialist expertise to the appropriate Application, Platform, Infrastructure, Network, Security, Identity, Project or supplier support team.
   

  

 The role is hands\-on and requires a strong technical foundation, sound judgement, clear communication and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The analyst will contribute to continual service improvement, automation, self\-service and the responsible use of approved AI\-enabled support tools.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
* Provide customer\-focused 1st and 2nd line IT support across agreed service channels.
* Log, categorise, prioritise and manage incidents, service requests and access queries in line with ITIL processes.
* Own tickets through to resolution or effective escalation, meeting agreed SLA and OLA targets while maintaining accurate records and proactive communication.
* Diagnose and resolve issues across Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Active Directory, Intune, MFA, VPN, network connectivity, devices and business applications.
* Complete approved access, joiner, mover and leaver activities, device provisioning, asset management and onboarding/offboarding tasks securely and accurately.
* Escalate issues requiring specialist expertise to the appropriate Application, Platform, Infrastructure, Network, Security, Identity, Project or supplier support team, retaining responsibility for ticket progression and user communication.
* Contribute to problem, change and major incident activities, including investigation, testing, deployment support, technical documentation and early\-life support.
* Apply least\-privilege, data protection and information security requirements, escalating suspected security incidents or control exceptions promptly.
* Create and maintain high\-quality knowledge articles, support guides and self\-service content, and provide user guidance or training where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, self\-service and support efficiency, using approved AI tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.
* Contribute to service improvement, supplier liaison, backlog reduction, ticket quality and customer satisfaction.
* Support the achievement of agreed service measures, including SLA/OLA performance, first\-contact resolution, customer satisfaction and accurate service records.
* Work flexibly within agreed service hours, shift arrangements and out\-of\-hours support requirements.


**Required Experience**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or equivalent knowledge and practical experience of ITIL service management principles.
* Demonstrable experience providing technical support in an IT Service Desk, IT Support or similar technology support environment.
* Demonstrable customer service experience, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with users.


**Desirable**
* Relevant Microsoft certification, such as Microsoft 365, Endpoint/Intune, Azure or Identity\-related certification.
* Relevant Service Management or technical certification, such as SDI Service Desk Analyst, CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+ or an equivalent qualification.


**Our Benefits**
* Competitive salary \+ annual bonus
* Flexible hybrid working
* Career development opportunities
* 25 days holiday (increasing to 28 after 5 years)
* Enhanced Maternity/Paternity pay
* 1 day paid charity day
* Company events and incentives
* 3x salary death in service benefit
* Pension scheme
* Private Medical Insurance or Healthcare Cash Plan
* Free breakfast and beverages


**Inclusive Recruitment at Travel Counsellors**
 Travel Counsellors is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, gender, disability, or any protected characteristic. We provide accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and will make every effort to accommodate reasonable adjustments where required. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our team and encourage all to apply.
   

  

 For more information about this role – and others – at Travel Counsellors, please do not hesitate to contact the Talent Acquisition team at talentacquisition@travelcounsellors.com

The team work together to keep Bauer Media’s UK businesses running smoothly, supporting colleagues across audio and publishing brands with a focus on helping each other and sharing knowledge.

We are currently recruiting for an IT Service Desk Analyst to provide high\-quality desktop, server and networking support, along with exceptional customer service to a small selection of clients within the designated support pod.

**What does this role involve?**
--------------------------------


This role is primarily office\-based, working from our Grantham location, with the potential for hybrid working arrangements after the probation period. Travel to customer sites will be required, so applicants must hold a full UK driving licence. A fleet of vehicles is available for client visits as and when needed.

### **Teamwork**


You’ll be a strong team player who enjoys working collaboratively with colleagues across IT and the wider organisation. You’ll share knowledge, support other team members, communicate effectively and work together to resolve issues quickly, while maintaining a friendly, professional and customer\-focused approach.

### **Client experience**


Provide a friendly, responsive and professional service, ensuring clients feel supported, valued and kept informed throughout.

**Skills and experience**
-------------------------


We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and capabilities to apply, although it’s essential that your values and experience align with this role’s key responsibilities. To be successful, you will:

* Provide remote and onsite support, with exceptional customer service to clients.
* Manage incidents, service requests and problems effectively.
* Identify documentation requirements, aim for continual improvement to make the client experience the best and suggest internal improvements to make service desk processes as efficient as possible.
* Ensure the service desk database is kept up to date.
* Understand and follow all policies and procedures.

**Skills and experience**
-------------------------

* IT experience on an MSP service desk would be beneficial
* Previous experience in an IT support role
* Excellent customer service skills
* Full Right to Work in the UK
* Full UK driving licence

**Join Duncan \& Toplis**
-------------------------


From flexible working arrangements and time\-matched volunteer hours to online fitness classes and mental health support, at Duncan \& Toplis we're committed to helping our people maintain a healthy and balanced lifestyle.


We help our team to develop their talents and encourage ambitious individuals to progress their careers and expand their professional and personal capability with fully supported training.


Our values of trust, partnership, and inclusivity are at the forefront of everything we do.

raw.title: Service Desk Analyst 2
raw.description:
**About The Role**
 The Service Desk Analyst will model the Netrio mission, vision, and values each day, functioning as a guide for daily accountabilities and responsibilities. This role is accountable for creating, updating and resolving technical service requests from customers and with speed and precision. This role is on the front line for reactive client requests, handling with a high level of accuracy and customer satisfaction. This role will require broad knowledge of our standard network engineering practices as well as learning specific knowledge for our clients to better help to serve each of them when the need arises. Customer service will be an important feature of this position as the Service Desk will typically be the first interaction a user may have with our company. Communication skills as well as technical skills will be the key components of this position.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****
* Answer calls and tickets submitted from clients through our various communication channels, including via phone, and email.
* Provide initial support for all calls and tickets received. If the issue requires additional support the Service Desk is unable to provide, it is their duty to escalate the problem accordingly.
* Collaborate with team members and escalate issues appropriately.
* Update/create tickets detailing any troubleshooting steps you took to ensure the problem can be picked up and put down by the other team members if necessary.
* Follow up on older tickets to ensure problems are fully resolved and that the customer is satisfied with the outcome.
* Document client specific information as needed to enable secured but easy access for future, related issues.
* Intake of packages and deliveries received to the office. Enter the information for each delivery into ConnectWise under the relevant client and mark that package for pickup by the engineer.
* May also be used to support the Project Team or Network Engineers in the initial preparation of the new client equipment, especially new workstations, when needed.


****KEY COMPETENCIES****
****Customer Focus****
* Provide clear communication and resolution regarding service requests to ensure customer satisfaction.


****Collaboration****
* Work effectively with peers and technical teams to ensure smooth workflow and issue resolution.


****Continuous Improvement****
* Identify gaps in documentation and processes to enhance efficiency and service delivery.


****Attention to Detail****
* Accurately manage and document service requests, ensuring proper tracking and resolution.


****Time Management****
* Efficiently manage multiple service requests while ensuring timely resolutions and meeting performance metrics.


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* Associates or Technical degree in Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 3\-5 years of experience in IT Support including knowledge of networking basics, Windows desktop environments, Windows OS and Office365\.
* Experience in a customer service environment.
* Ability to use deductive reasoning to troubleshoot problems and resolve the issues using IT knowledge.
* Ability to learn and track down information needed to resolve new problem as they occur.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Time management skills, and the ability to prioritize multiple concurrent issues.
* The ability to work independently but also be a team player.
* Thriving in a fast\-paced environment. Performing well under pressure.
* Being a fast learner, who can keep up with changing trends in a rapidly evolving industry.


**About Netrio**
 Netrio is a leading MSP in North America, specializing in IT solutions for mid\-market to enterprise customers. We serve over 1,000 clients across industries with services including managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, connectivity, voice, and custom application development.

Demonstrated experience in incident management, ticket logging, and triaging.
Proven ability to document technical processes and communicate with non-technical stakeholders.

**The Helpdesk Engineer is the first point of contact for our clients when they need technical help, and the person who sees most issues through to resolution. You will answer calls, respond to emails and portal tickets, log and categorise incidents accurately, and fix as much as you can at first contact. You will then take ownership of the 2nd line work that follows, investigating more involved faults across desktops, servers, Microsoft 365 and networks, and escalating to our Senior Engineers only where an issue genuinely needs their depth of expertise.** 




**This is a hands on role that suits somebody who enjoys solving problems, takes real pride in a tidy ticket queue, and likes talking to people as much as fixing things. You will be supported by an experienced engineering team and there is a clear route to grow into 3rd line and project work as your skills develop.** 




**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**▪ Act as the first point of contact for client support requests by telephone, email and the service desk portal, providing a friendly, professional and reassuring experience.** 




**▪ Log, categorise and prioritise all incidents and service requests accurately in the service desk system, ensuring tickets are kept up to date with clear, well written notes.** 




**▪ Diagnose and resolve 1st line issues at first contact wherever possible, covering Windows desktops and laptops, Microsoft 365, printing, user accounts, passwords, connectivity and common business applications.** 




**▪ Carry out routine service requests such as new user set ups, leavers, permission changes, mailbox configuration and device builds following DSM standard procedures.** 




**▪ Own and resolve 2nd line issues including Windows Server and Active Directory administration, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID configuration, networking faults, backup checks and remote monitoring alerts, using our RMM and remote tools.** 




**▪ Escalate issues that need 3rd line or specialist input to Senior Engineers promptly and with complete, relevant information, and take ownership of keeping the client informed until resolution.** 




**▪ Monitor the ticket queue and alerting tools, chasing open tickets, meeting agreed response and resolution targets, and flagging anything at risk of breaching SLA.** 




**▪ Follow DSM security and compliance procedures at all times, including identity verification, change control and data handling, and help clients to do the same.** 




**▪ Contribute to and maintain the internal knowledge base and client documentation so that fixes are repeatable and the whole team benefits.** 




**▪ Support the wider engineering team with project work, on site visits and asset management as required.** 




**▪ Participate in the team rota to provide cover across our core support hours.**

**▪ Excellent telephone manner and clear written English** 




**▪ Solid working knowledge of Windows 10 and 11, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or Active Directory administration** 




**▪ Good understanding of networking including IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, VPN and Wi Fi troubleshooting** 




**▪ Logical, methodical approach to troubleshooting** 




**▪ Strong organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy queue** 




**▪ A team player who takes ownership and asks for help when needed** 




**▪ Self motivated and comfortable working independently from home with a reliable internet connection** 




**▪ Full UK driving licence, or working towards one, for occasional client site visits** 




**Desirable** 




**▪ Experience with Windows Server, Hyper V or VMware** 




**▪ Exposure to firewalls and switching such as WatchGuard, Fortinet or Ubiquiti** 




**▪ Familiarity with a PSA or ticketing system such as ConnectWise, Autotask or HaloPSA** 




**▪ Experience with remote monitoring and management tools** 




**▪ Awareness of cyber security fundamentals and Cyber Essentials** 




**▪ CompTIA A\+, Network\+ or Microsoft fundamentals certifications** 




**▪ Experience supporting VoIP telephony or mobile devices** 




**WHAT WE OFFER** 




**▪ A supportive, experienced team who will invest time in your development.** 




**▪ Exposure to a broad range of technologies across end user support, hosted infrastructure, security and our own data centre.** 




**▪ Hybrid working that gives you the flexibility of working from home alongside time with the team in Peterborough.** 




**▪ A friendly, down to earth team that values getting the job done well over being seen at a desk.** 



* **NO AGENCIES PLEASE**

raw.title: IT Support Analyst
raw.description:
For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well\-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about.


**Job Overview**
----------------

**Are you an experienced IT Support Analyst and looking for your next role?**

  

Charles River Laboratories are looking to recruit for an **IT Support Analyst** to join on a full time, permanent basis. This is a hybrid role, with expectation for this person to be onsite at least 3 days/week at our world class facility in High Peak, UK.

  

  

Reporting into the IT Support Services Manager you'll be responsible for providing IT support to the wider operational team across all levels to ensure all systems are available and functioning as needed. There may be occasional need to travel to our sites in Edinburgh and Margate.  



This role would suit an experienced IT Support Analyst/Technician who is looking for their next opportunity and wants to join a global organisation with further opportunity to develop and grow!

  

**Responsibilities:**

Our Information Technology department provides a wide range of IT services to all divisions of the Charles River organisation, across numerous sites in the UK.

  

Technology used: MS Windows Operating Systems (10/11\), MS Windows Server (2019/2025\) Active Director, Office365, Office Suite, SCCM, Bomgar, Remote Desktop, Lab Applications (Watson /Chemdraw/Masslynx/Analyst/WinnonLin), General Desktop User Applications.

  

Main Duties:  



  

* The configuration, support and routine administration of IT equipment including PC’s, laptops, mobile devices, printers. Working to support new hire onboarding \- ensuring equipment is ready and available as needed.
* Gather and document functional and technical requirements and consult with the user community to turn those requirements into an appropriate funded project.
* Perform break/fix analysis for individual and recurring support issues. Document findings and work with appropriate resources to find and deliver cost effective and timely solutions when needed.
* Monitor queue in the Service Desk software tool and follow appropriate guidelines for ensuring that the ITIL processes are followed within approved SLAs. Monitor queue KPIs and provide solutions to improve results.
* Perform root cause analysis of complex incidents or recurring problems affecting multiple sites. Develop solutions to those problems. Document in the problem resolution knowledge database and develop training materials to resolve ongoing issues or improve knowledge.
* Develop new processes and procedures to improve existing services, or to assist in deploying new support services.
* Create the training and communications materials for new and enhanced services. Implement training for medium to large scale service rollouts.
* Participate in and document status of change management for site services.
* Ensure work is compliant with applicable guidelines and regulations (e.g. SOP, GxP)
* Coordinate with approved vendors for orders and requirements for supported sites, and projects.
* Setting and amending permissions on folders/shares on a windows file server and Sharepoint / Teams environment.
* Building laptops, desktops and installing software using SCCM.
* Being the IT representative for site related change management processes.
**Requirements and Profile**
----------------------------

* GCSEs in English and Maths as a minimum. Additional IT/Technical Qualifications are desirable.
* Relevant experience in technical support and troubleshooting desktop client hardware and software issues, such as operating systems, MS Office suite, Internet Explorer, and other desktop applications in an enterprise environment.
* In\-depth knowledge and extensive hands\-on experience in desktop operating system maintenance and troubleshooting, and installation and support of MS Windows operating systems.
* Ability to support, maintain, and troubleshoot MS Office suite of productivity tools, and hands\-on experience of Edge and other CRL core applications such as anti\-virus software, MS Outlook, Remote Access technologies/VPN utilities, SCCM, Lotus Notes, Adobe Acrobat and other Adobe products.
* Ability to plan and organize work schedules and coordinate schedules to meet work priorities and service levels.
* Working knowledge of MS Windows compatible desktop and laptop hardware and use required.
* Knowledge and experience in various LAN technologies, such as: TCP/IP, Fast Ethernet, Hubs, Switches, and Routers.
* Good interpersonal skills to deal with customers, colleagues, and other technical staff in a courteous and friendly manner.
* Ability to work in a multicultural environment with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
* Candidates must have a full, clean driving license and their own transport.

  

All applicants must have full and permanent Right to Work in the UK as we are unable to provide sponsorship for this role.

  

  

**The salary range for this position is upto £39,000/annum \+ bonus \+ benefits. Please note that the salary varies within the range based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, education, certifications, and location.**

**About Safety Assessment**  

Charles River is committed to helping our partners expedite their preclinical drug development with exceptional safety assessment services, state\-of\-the\-art facilities and expert regulatory guidance. From individual specialty toxicology and IND enabling studies to tailored packages and total laboratory support, our deeply experienced team can design and execute programs that anticipate challenges and avoid roadblocks for a smooth, efficient journey to market. Each year approximately 300 investigational new drug (IND) programs are conducted in our Safety Assessment facilities.

  

**About Charles River**  

Charles River is an early\-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non\-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

  

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

  

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well\-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

  

At Charles River Laboratories, we recognize and recruit all talent. We are a company committed to fostering a sense of belonging and work daily in this direction.

* Complete Install, Move, Add, Change activity via a ServiceNow Service Requests.

* Coordinating SOHO Kit configuration/shipment for existing employees and new starters.
* Understand principles and practices of ITIL standards.
* Providing conference room equipment support and upkeep.
* Provide support for all office hardware – laptops, thin clients, peripherals, printers, etc.
* Perform PC maintenance, repair, analysis, and testing.
* Assists in creating documentation for self\-service end\-user support knowledge base and for team members as an internal knowledge base and best practice sharing.
* Support the end user experience by being an ambassador of our environment and enabling them to use the technology.
* Liaising with Vendors relating to Incidents and service requests reported by users.
* Utilising ServiceNow platform for triage of End User Support tickets


**Our Must\-haves**
* Solid experience in supporting end users in a larger organization.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving WAN/LAN print related issues.
* Experience in supporting Microsoft Managed Desktop \- Laptops
* Experience with Service NOW and JIRA for tracking of issues and projects
* Experience in Microsoft Office (2016, 2019, 2021, or O365\)
* Experience with Cisco WebEx technology and experience in AV conference rooms technology.
* Solid understanding of MacOS, Windows OS and MS Office products.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Superb communication and customer service skills
* Understanding of desktop virtualization technologies and tools, this will be advantageous, although not a necessity.
* Experience with TCP/IP and IP addressing.
* Experience with O365/M365 endpoint management and Intune.
* Up to 20% travel required.


**Who We Are**
 Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a Fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20\+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory, and investment operations around the world.
   

  

**We’re all about people \| We win together \| We strive for better \| We enjoy the everyday \| We think further**
**What’s in it for you?**
* A great starting salary plus annual bonus \& strong benefits package…
* 25 days paid holiday plus Bank Holidays, with the opportunity to buy/sell extra leave
* Fantastic company pension scheme, private medical and dental cover, life assurance, travel insurance cover, income protection, season ticket loan as well as other great benefits on offer
* There are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career and we can provide the support needed to do just that!


**Are you ready to play your part?**

 **‘Apply Now’** 
 to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.

We are also happy to consider candidates who are looking for flexible working patterns.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with all reasonable accommodations to be able to participate in the job application or interview process and to perform essential job functions if successful. * .

Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.  

  

### **The Role**


The Senior Tier 3 Technical Support Engineer (TSE) is a trusted advisor to the broader Outreach Technical Support team, as well as an entry\-point for back\-line Technical Support delivery. This role delivers on a broad range of Tier 3 Technical Support responsibilities across the organization. The Senior Tier 3 TSE serves as a key cross\-functional collaborator helping drive resolutions of our most complex technical support issues. The role partners with Technical Support Delivery, Technical Escalations Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product Management, and Product Engineering. The Senior Tier 3 TSE serves as a subject matter in at least one product functional area and can effectively investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve a wide variety of technical issues. This role plays a central part in our mission\-critical incident management process.  

**Location**

While we are remote\-friendly, we remain an "office\-centric" company. This role is categorized as hybrid and it is expected you live in **a reasonable proximity to the office in London** so you would be able to connect with your team on weekly regular basis, attend in\-person meetings and company events.

**This is a full\-time, permanent role, not eligible for contractors and for work from other countries.**  

### **NOTE:**



The offer is contingent upon successfully passing the background screening process.



### **Your Daily Adventures Will Include**



* Serve as the primary point of escalation for technical support issues requiring advanced troubleshooting, accurate reproduction, log analysis, and technical context
* Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one product\-functional area, and be able to conduct advanced troubleshooting across the broader product functional areas
* Serve as the technical escalation point and customer advocate with Outreach’s Product Engineering team
* Regularly resolves moderately complex customer problems requiring investigation across multiple systems, logs, configurations, or workflows, applying structured analytical thinking to identify probable root causes
* Participate in the incident response rotation throughout the entire incident lifecycle, including incident detection, incident management, customer communications, and root cause analysis
* Regularly takes ownership of escalations from frontline support teams, employing methodical troubleshooting and support processes to efficiently identify, triage, and resolve customer issues
* Contribute to operational process improvements, mentor team members, and identify recurring support trends
* Deliver SME/Support Stakeholder feedback throughout product release readiness activities
* Contribute to enablement activities including KB article creation, mentoring, swarming duties
* Develop a skillset around leveraging AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, issue resolution, enablement
* Balance reactive escalation handling with proactive identification of product gaps, documentation improvements, and customer experience enhancements
* Meet or exceed most Support Scorecard metrics while contributing to support content, internal documentation, and process refinement
### **Our Vision of You**



**Required**



* 2–5 years of technical support or production\-support experience, demonstrating increasing scope and impact in supporting customers in complex SaaS/Enterprise software environment
* Demonstrated ability to independently investigate and resolve moderately complex issues spanning multiple systems, logs, and configurations
* Demonstrated ability to learn new and evolving technologies
* Experience partnering directly with Engineering teams on defect analysis, reproduction, and root\-cause investigation
* Able to work independently on most assigned responsibilities, managing day\-to\-day priorities with limited oversight.
* Communicates clearly and proactively with internal and external stakeholders, providing structured, accurate status updates during troubleshooting and escalations
* Demonstrates sound judgment while balancing customer expectations, technical limitations, business priorities, and operational efficiency
* Experience with log analysis/observability tools such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, etc

  


**Nice to Have**



* Experience supporting CRM Platforms such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics
* Experience with enterprise email systems \& infrastructure, including troubleshooting email deliverability
* Experience with VoIP (Twilio), investigating call quality and related infrastructure and networking issues
* Experience with ticketing systems such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, JIRA

* Working knowledge of Authentication Protocols/SSO such as SAML and OAuth
* Working knowledge REST API and testing tools such as Postman
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals
* Experience participating in incident response
**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* 25 days holiday \+ 8 bank holidays


* Outreach contributes with monthly contribution towards your pension


* Private medical care for employee and spouse/family with Program Health Plus


* Cashplan is offered through Medicash to help offset out of pocket medical related expenses

* A parental leave program that includes not just extended time off but options for a paid night nurse


* Opportunity to be part of company success via equity program


* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN\+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA\+), Gender\+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military


* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team



*Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.***

jobs.title: French Speaking Front Office IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: **French Speaking Front Office IT Support Engineer** **Join MARGO in the UK (London)** MARGO is a tech\-native consultancy delivering high value\-added IT expertise to the financial services industry. We operate in complex Front Office environments where technology, trading activity and production constraints intersect. Our consultants support and operate mission\-critical trading systems used by Front Office, trading and risk teams, in contexts where responsiveness, reliability and technical understanding are essential. Joining MARGO means working in demanding Front Office environments, while benefiting from a human\-sized structure, close follow\-up and tailored training paths. **About the Role** We are looking for a **French\-speaking Front Office IT Support Engineer** to join our team in London, supporting live, production\-critical trading systems for a Tier\-1 Investment Bank. The team operates in high\-pressure Front Office environments where responsiveness, common sense, and clear communication matter most. While technical basics are necessary, we hire primarily for mindset. **The team can teach you the rest.** **What the Team Can Teach You** You don't need to know everything on day one. If you have strong foundations, **the team can teach you:** * Our specific Front Office trading systems, electronic execution workflows, and market data platforms. * Advanced Linux/UNIX commands, internal scripting, and complex production investigation tools. * The intricate technical setup of a Tier\-1 Investment Bank’s trading infrastructure. * Deep\-dive financial domain knowledge, asset class mechanics, and trade lifecycle details. **What the Team Is Looking For** We are looking for a candidate who brings the right attitude, communication skills, and problem\-solving instinct. **The team is looking for:** * **Fluent French \& English:** Strong communication skills in both languages to interact smoothly across teams. * **Genuine Financial Curiosity:** An eager mindset that looks "beyond the database." You don’t need to be a quant, but you should actually want to understand the real financial products (bonds, swaps, equities) behind the data strings. * **Pragmatism \& Resourcefulness:** A smart problem\-solver who prioritizes ruthlessly. You secure quick wins for simple issues and avoid falling down one\-hour technical rabbit holes over minor glitches while traders are waiting. * **The "Translator" Ability:** Social intelligence to act as a bridge between two different worlds. You know how to talk to a stressed trader without drowning them in server logs, and you can explain issues to developers without confusing them with trading jargon. * **Solid IT Foundations:** Basic\-to\-intermediate experience with Linux/UNIX command line and SQL for querying databases. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide live, real\-time IT support for Front Office trading platforms during market hours. * Monitor real\-time trading activity, investigate system behavior, and resolve production incidents. * Manage real\-time market data configurations and support electronic execution workflows. * Collaborate closely with both Trading Desks and Development/Infrastructure teams. * Participate in change management, testing, and system release deployments. **Requirements** * **Languages:** Fluent French and English (written and spoken). * **Technical Baseline:** Prior experience in IT support with working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and basic SQL. **Why Join MARGO** · Access to demanding Front Office trading environments · Exposure to live trading systems and business users · Progressive technical and functional development paths · Human\-sized consultancy with close support and tailored training · Long\-term career opportunities across support, engineering and development **Please note \- We do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.**

raw.description:
**Methods Business and Digital Technology Limited**


Methods is a £100M\+ IT Services Consultancy who has partnered with a range of central government departments and agencies to transform the way the public sector operates in the UK. Established over 30 years ago and UK\-based, we apply our skills in transformation, delivery, and collaboration from across the Methods Group, to create end\-to\-end business and technical solutions that are people\-centred, safe, and designed for the future.


Our human touch sets us apart from other consultancies, system integrators and software houses \- with people, technology, and data at the heart of who we are, we believe in creating value and sustainability through everything we do for our clients, staff, communities, and the planet.


We support our clients in the success of their projects while working collaboratively to share skill sets and solve problems. At Methods we have fun while working hard; we are not afraid of making mistakes and learning from them.


Predominantly focused on the public\-sector, Methods is now building a significant private sector client portfolio.


Methods was acquired by the Alten Group in early 2022\.


The Principal Service Desk Analyst, like the Senior and Service Desk Analyst, is there to achieve the resolution (both reactive and proactive) of problems throughout the information system lifecycle, including classification, prioritisation and initiation of action, documentation of root causes and implementation of remedies to prevent future incidents. They also process and coordinate appropriate and timely responses to incident reports, including the channelling of requests for help to appropriate functions for resolution, monitoring resolution activity, and keeping customers appraised of progress towards service restoration.


The Principal Service Desk Analyst is an escalation point for the Service Desk Team and is required to deliver advanced problem resolution, working with internal and/or external resources where necessary. In addition, they will assist with analysis of trends and patterns across the IT environment and lead Service Desk projects assigned to them. The Principal Service Desk Analyst will deputise for the Service Desk Team Leader at times of high workload or absence.

**Accountabilities:**

* Timely answering of support queries from both customers and colleagues
* Maintain ownership of escalated issues through to resolution
* Help junior colleagues use various sources to find potential solutions
* Discuss resolution of complex problems with colleagues to help them successfully resolve similar issues in the future
* Communicate relevant updates in daily ‘stand ups’ and as requested
* Collaborate with peers across the wider organisation to bring additional knowledge into Managed Services
* Share knowledge with team members
* Support the development of junior colleagues by modelling desirable behaviours
* Ensure patch management is effective and all customer assets within our scope of responsibility are updated with the latest patches
* Provide updates, status, and completion information to management

  



**Responsibilities:**

* Provide consistent high\-quality support to internal and external customers, taking ownership of user problems and proactively dealing with any issues preventing resolution.

* Proactively identify and communicate current and potential issues using a variety of methods including monitoring and service management tools
* Identify and communicate opportunities for upstream process changes and/or system configuration changes
* Create, use and share PowerShell scripts for device, server, account, and resource configuration and management tasks
* Deliver a high standard of customer service for all support queries
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, capturing sufficiently detailed information from customers.
* Document and share troubleshooting techniques used to successfully resolve complex problems
* Update records of customer environments to reflect actions taken
* Respond in a timely manner to proactive monitoring alerts to meet contractual Service Level Agreements.
* Stay up\-to\-date on customers' application landscapes
* Analyse and improve knowledge database to reduce resolution times and improve contact outcomes
* Collaborate with technical resources from both internal and external IT Teams/Business Units/Vendors
* Visit customer sites when required.
* Train and/or mentor Service Desk Analysts and Senior Service Desk Analysts
* Deputise for the Service Desk Manager at times of high workload and/or absence
* Any other duties as and when required commensurate with organisational position

 **Requirements** **Essential Requirements**

* Experience of working on a Service Desk
* Strong analytical and creative problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes in complex scenarios.
* Locate and evaluate relevant information effectively and efficiently
* Excellent communication skills via various channels.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical information to a non\-technical audience.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical information with a technical audience.
* Learn quickly and keep up to date with the latest technology advancements.
* Use time management techniques to work efficiently under own initiative, while demonstrating effective teamwork.
* Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to meet the needs of demanding workloads.
* Deliver high quality work within the expected timescale to meet customer service level expectations.
* Have a broad and deep knowledge of server and desktop operating systems, networks and office systems, plus Microsoft cloud offerings.
* Competent in PowerShell programming/scripting
* Demonstrate an ethos of continual business and professional development
* Embrace a passion for IT and technology.
* A proven focus and ability to deliver effective customer service, achieving high levels of customer satisfaction through professional attitudes and consideration towards the customer’s own knowledge.
* Willingness and ability to work during weekends and out‐of‐hours when necessary (additional compensation for these hours of working will apply in line with T\&Cs).

 **Desirable Requirements**

* Previous training or mentoring experience

* Advanced knowledge of server administration activities
* Advanced knowledge of Windows server components
* Advanced knowledge of Linux server components
* Advanced knowledge of networking principles and components
* Advanced knowledge of Azure platform components

* Microsoft Certifications

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.


At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top\-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18\), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

**About the role**


As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.


You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.


You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.


You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day\-to\-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

**What you’ll do**

* **Lead and develop the team.** Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.
* **Own support quality.** Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow\-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.
* **Build a dependable support operation.** Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.
* **Strengthen technical capability.** Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.
* **Lead significant customer escalations.** Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.
* **Make collaboration effective.** Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.
* **Improve the product through support.** Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.
* **Make support easier to deliver.** Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.
* **Use evidence to guide decisions.** Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

**What we’re looking for**

* Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers.
* A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers.
* Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows.
* Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain.
* Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders.
* Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities.
* Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation.
* The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence.
* Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day\-to\-day work.

**Experience that would be useful**

* Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business.
* Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations.
* Leading support across different time zones.
* Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self\-service or automation.
* Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies.

*You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring.*

**What success looks like**


During your first six months:

* Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans.
* Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication.
* You have established a trustworthy baseline for support performance and delivered measurable improvements in the most important areas.
* Escalations reach the right teams with better evidence and fewer unnecessary handovers.
* Recurring problems are being addressed through product changes, documentation or tooling.
* Duffel has a clear plan for the support capacity and capabilities needed as the business grows.

**Why Join Duffel?**
--------------------


We’re a growth\-focused team that values open communication, diverse perspectives, and true ownership. We want you to feel empowered in your role, which is why every permanent employee becomes a company shareholder.

  

**Live Your Best Life**

* **Duffel Travel Allowance:** We subsidise your wanderlust.
* **Work From Anywhere (60 days):** Your office, your rules.
* **Sabbaticals:** Long\-term loyalty, long\-term breaks.
* **Flexible Bank Holidays:** Swap holidays to suit your schedule.


**Level Up \& Give Back**

* **Study Days:** Get paid to learn.
* **Volunteering Day:** One day a year to save the world.
* **Electric Car \& Cycle Schemes:** Eco\-friendly rides, tax\-free prices.


**The Essentials, Upgraded**

* **Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption):** Big support for life’s biggest moments, **26 weeks fully paid.**
* **Pensions \& Loans:** Future\-proofing and interest\-free commuting.
* **Eye Tests:** Keeping your vision (and your style) sharp.

### **We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone \- regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.**


### ***Note to recruitment agencies*** ***Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void.***
